verdict: Render matches the original geometry closely; the only discrepancy is the D label, which sits up-right of its vertex instead of directly above it.

issues.description: The label D is drawn up and to the right of vertex D (about 25 px right of the vertex at this scale). In the original, D is centred directly above its vertex.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the D label to point up (e.g. node[above] at D) rather than an offset anchor such as above right, so the label is centred over D.
